bootstrap_holds_fixed: family admission (the full V(R)) is not re-evaluated; the resample re-forms iota_R and iota_A and re-runs the ranking and structural selection over the families the pilot found LOCAL-valid, so the probability is a lower bound on the frozen triple's total variability
rule: MATERIAL when some admissible alternative triple's total distance is within 1 bootstrap SE of the primary triple's, or the registered ranking re-selects the frozen triple on fewer than 0.6667 of 2000 topic resamples
selection_unchanged: R1/R2/R3 remain the frozen primary triple and R4/R5 the frozen backups. Delta_R(f) is re-formed over every admissible triple of the five frozen families from the same generated cells in the confirmatory analysis (confirm/analysis.py, member family F_REFSENS, planned on the MEMBERSHIP record's reference_sensitivity block). This tool selects nothing.
